title: Incident Report
summary: Use this form to report a suspected Excess Time Event. The Department administers consequences. It does not create causes.

title: Recovered Hours Declaration
summary: Declare hours that have returned after a recognised displacement. Do not estimate. Record only what can be shown.

title: Chronological Damage Claim
summary: Claim for demonstrable effects upon public or private life arising from a recognised Excess Time Event.

title: Lost Afternoon Notification
summary: Notify the Department of an afternoon that failed to arrive where it was expected. Localised events are, in most cases, resolved without lasting consequence.

title: Memory Continuity Assessment
summary: Request an assessment where a day appears to have occurred but cannot be adequately reconstructed. The Department does not regulate memory.

title: Application for Research Access
summary: Apply to consult holdings of the Institute for Temporal Studies. Authorised researchers only.

title: Staff surplus hours return
summary: For officers of the Department only. Return surplus hours arising in the course of duty.

title: Community programme nomination
summary: Nominate a community, school or local authority for a programme under DET-COM-012.

title: Schools visit request
summary: Request a departmental visit or teaching pack. The Department does not teach history. It teaches continuity.

title: Subject access request (temporal records)
summary: Ask whether the Department holds records in which you appear. Some holdings are not yet eligible for disclosure.

title: Application for employment
summary: Civil service application. Use the vacancy reference from the notice.
